name: Hudson Valley
about: Fall foliage (early-to-mid Oct) is the busiest weekend-tripper season from New York City; spring and summer are quieter and good for hiking and farm visits.
overview: Historic Hudson River estates, world-class contemporary art at Dia:Beacon and Storm King, and the landscape that inspired America's first great painting movement — an easy escape from New York City.
costOverview: An easy day trip or weekend from NYC that stays reasonable outside peak fall weekends — the major art institutions (Dia:Beacon, Storm King) are the main real ticket costs.
monthlyWeather: cold, quiet with the fewest weekend visitors from the city
